blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY — Classes at all levels in public and private schools here will be suspended on Thursday, October 8, for National Teachers’ Day and National Teachers’ Month. Mayor Frederick Siao issued the order to recognize teachers’ vital role in nation-building, pursuant to Republic Act No. 10743, which declares October 5 of every year as National Teachers’ Day.
